moat_source: Brand plus Coca-Cola global distribution network (scale); international sales +44.9% y/y riding a distribution moat competitors cannot replicate
primary_model_risk: Terminal FCF multiple: the stock trades ~47x trailing earnings/FCF; the base case already grants a premium 28x exit on year-5 FCF. Each 2-turn change moves IV roughly $4-5/share; if the market keeps paying 40x+ the model is too conservative, if energy-drink growth matures to staples multiples (20x) the bear case governs.
expectations_gap_key_variable: FCF conversion: the price (~47x FCF) requires ~20%+ FCF growth compounding for years; Q1 revenue momentum (+26.9%) supports the P&L but FY2025 FCF was only $1.97B and gross margin is compressing (55.0% vs 56.5%), so the cash-flow path implied by the price is steeper than the reported cash-flow trend
top_5_bull_arguments: Fastest growth in a decade: Q1 2026 net sales +26.9% to $2.35B, first $2B+ quarter, 8.9% consensus beat
International engine: +44.9% y/y to ~45% of sales on Coca-Cola distribution; China/India still early
New-product wave already ~15% of US sales since Sep 2025 launches - innovation flywheel is working
Net cash balance sheet ($5.08 cash/share, current ratio 3.26) with ~$400M buyback authorization remaining
Management $10B FY2027 revenue glidepath would make current estimates look low if hit
top_5_bear_arguments: Price already exceeds the FactSet mean target ($93.55) after a +31.6% 90-day run - re-rating has front-run the results
~47x trailing P/E and ~47x FCF for a beverage company, with gross margin compressing 150bps y/y
International mix shift is structurally margin-dilutive (aluminum, freight, geographic mix)
FY2025 FCF $1.97B implies FCF conversion lagging the revenue narrative; buyback pace (~$100M/qtr) is immaterial at a $95B cap
Regulatory overhang on energy drinks (caffeine/youth marketing) is unpriced at a premium multiple
thesis_breakers: International net sales growth decelerating below ~20% y/y for two consecutive quarters
Gross margin falling below 53% (accelerating erosion beyond mix effects)
Revenue tracking materially below the ~$10B-by-FY2027 management glidepath
FCF failing to grow toward $2.5B+ annualized while the P&L compounds - conversion gap widening
position_size_recommendation: None at current price; revisit below ~$76 (expected IV) or after the Aug 10 split-related flow settles
